topic: Honey found in Egyptian tombs is still perfectly edible after 3000 years
hook: Honey found in Egyptian tombs is still edible after 3000 years.
script: Honey found in Egyptian tombs is still edible after 3000 years. Archaeologists discovered honey sealed in ancient Egyptian pottery that dated back over 3000 years. They tasted it. Still good. Honey's chemical composition — low moisture, high acidity, hydrogen peroxide — makes it effectively immortal. It never expires. No bacteria can survive inside it. Follow for facts about nature's most perfect food.
